Regulation: B.C. Reg. 164/2026
Made under: Assessment Act
Published in: No. 18 – B.C. Regs. 164 to 165, October 20, 2026
Deposit date: October 13, 2026

B.C. Reg. 164/2026, deposited October 13, 2026, under theASSESSMENT ACT[section 19 (14.01)]. Order in Council 416/2026, approved and ordered October 13, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that the Prescribed Classes of Property Regulation, B.C. Reg. 438/81, is amended as set out in the attached Appendix. — L. POPHAM,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	The Prescribed Classes of Property Regulation, B.C. Reg. 438/81, is amended by repealing Schedule B and substituting the following: 1An assessment roll number set out in column 1 of the table in section 2 is the number on the assessment roll prepared by the assessment authority for the 2027 taxation year. Designated eligible supportive housing properties 2For the purposes of section 19 (14.01) of theAssessment Act, the eligible supportive housing properties identified by the assessment roll numbers listed in column 1 of the following table are designated for the 2027 taxation year: Index Page|Next Regulation|Cumulative Index Page Copyright © 2026: King's Printer, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada

minutes_briefs.title: BC designates supportive housing properties for 2027 tax treatment under Assessment Act
minutes_briefs.summary: BC Regulation 164/2026 amends the Prescribed Classes of Property Regulation under the Assessment Act. It replaces Schedule B and lists specific assessment roll numbers that identify eligible supportive housing properties for the 2027 taxation year. These designated properties get special property tax treatment under section 19 (14.01) of the Assessment Act. The regulation was deposited on October 13, 2026 and published on October 20, 2026.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Check whether your property's assessment roll number appears on the new Schedule B list, and confirm your 2027 property tax classification with BC Assessment.

key_dates.label: BC supportive housing property designation applies for 2027 tax year
